nodes.odebrane.text.t: The carpenter opens the box and tips a handful of nails into his apron pocket. "That'll do. Tell Gudrun I'll pay next time, and you I'll give something right now, because I can see you've worked up a sweat."

nodes.s.text.t: The carpenter taps his hammer on an empty crate and sighs. "Nails are the only thing we're short of here. That and patience."
